coverage.protocol_source_caveat: origin/coordination/swarm-control was unreachable from this worker environment, so the protocol constants were taken from the in-repo restatement. If the coordination branch says otherwise, the coordination branch wins and this freeze needs a correction.
coverage.auxiliary_policy: the v2 corpus holds required cells only. Auxiliary families are out of scope for this freeze and are not folded into any required cell, because merging several task types into one qualification cell lets a strong sub-type mask a weak one.

independence_design.why_this_shape: within one cell the fifteen inputs differ on two independent axes at once: five task variants with different instructions and output contracts, and three distinct structural loads per variant. Two inputs in the same cell therefore differ in both wording and payload arity, so neither is a re-skin of the other.

content_digest_binding.bound_by: whoever mints the sealed bundle, outside this branch

sealed_reference.closes_v1_blocker_b2: v1 held expected_output, grader, reference_solution and broken_code in plaintext inside benchmarks/starter.jsonl. A v2 record has no field in which any of those could sit.

foreign_corpora.why_foreign: every split of the v1 pool is treated as contaminating. Its calibration split is used for screening, and its held-out split is burned because its reference answers were worker-visible in plaintext. No v2 held-out input may share a case id, payload digest, rendered prompt digest or normalised template with any v1 record.
